description: A resizable text display for a block of text.
notes: the display starts empty; click it and type. It takes the keyboard like any text field, and what you type is saved with the patch.
the module is resized by dragging its top corners, from 5HP to 20HP.
a TF-101 or TF-102 placed immediately to the left or right sets the formatting instead, with no cable.
menu: Text Size: — a field taking the size of the text in points, 6 to 26.
Foreground — a submenu setting the colour of the text: a field taking a hex colour, then Blue, Yellow, Red, Green, Orange, Pink, White and Black.
Background — a submenu setting the colour behind the text: a field taking a hex colour, then None, Black and White.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
